description: Runs the saved Playwright test of a `scenario` monitor now, off schedule, with the same consequences as a scheduled run: a point on the graph, and an incident opened or closed. Waits for the run to finish — up to the monitor `request_timeout` plus browser start-up — and returns the verdict, the failed test, the Playwright error and the test console output. The screenshot, video and trace links in the response work for an hour. One on-demand run per account at a time and at most 30 in 10 minutes (409 and 429 otherwise). If the client gives up waiting, `monitor_get_scenario_run_latest` returns the result.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: monitor_run_scenario
title: Run scenario now
